Data Pipeline Pocket Reference
Data pipelines are the foundation for success in data analytics.
Moving data from numerous diverse sources and transforming
it to provide context is the difference between having data
and actually gaining value from it. This pocket reference defines
data pipelines and explains how they work in today's modern
data stack.
You'll learn common considerations and key decision points
when implementing pipelines, such as batch versus streaming
data ingestion and build versus buy. This book addresses
the most common decisions made by data professionals and
discusses foundational concepts that apply to open source
frameworks, commercial products, and homegrown solutions.
+ What a data pipeline is and how it works
+ How data is moved and processed on modern data

infrastructure, including cloud platforms
+ Common tools and products used by data engineers

to build pipelines
+ How pipelines support analytics and reporting needs
+ Considerations for pipeline maintenance, testing,

and alerting
